verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a Servers API for creating, editing, listing and deleting servers, and each server authenticates with its own Server API Token. This gives a documented first-party way to stand up tenant-like units with separate credentials, alongside message streams and unlimited custom sending domains. The evidence does not show per-tenant suppression lists, and reputation separation is only implied by dedicated IPs, which require 300k+ emails/month. missing for 10: documented per-server/per-stream suppression lists, per-tenant reputation isolation beyond high-volume dedicated IPs, explicit multi-tenant/subaccount guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can isolate tenants — subaccounts, subusers, or multiple domains with separate credentials, suppression lists, and reputation — for the platform I'm building

citations.quote: Servers \- Get a server \- Create a server \- Edit a server \- List servers \- Delete a server
All API requests require authentication using the `X-Postmark-Server-Token` header with your Server API Token
Dedicated IPs: Fully managed dedicated IPs, available to customers sending 300,000 emails per month or more.
